provenance.source_notes: Reference for this template's layout and text came from screenshots the Forza Writer user supplied directly (in-game/in-editor captures), not from any file, image, or asset extracted or downloaded from the game itself or an official tool. Only one plate exists in Phasmophobia (the player team's Iveco Eurocargo 75E18 van/truck, a static, one-of-a-kind prop, not a per-vehicle-type plate family the way most other templates in this set model a whole in-game standard), so a single template fully covers it -- there's no second variant to build. Registration 'GHD666' -- read from the supplied screenshot as '7GHD666' -- and 'GHD' standing for 'Ghost Huntin' Distribution' (the in-game company name) are independently corroborated by the Phasmophobia Fandom wiki's Truck page, not just the one screenshot. The smaller text along the plate's bottom is not independently confirmed beyond the user's own best-effort reading of a dark, low-resolution screenshot as 'GHOST HUNTIN' DIST.' -- a plausible abbreviated expansion of 'GHD' given the wiki-confirmed company name, but not a verbatim transcription anyone has corroborated. Plain black-on-white is a standard, unremarkable US plate color scheme and reads that way in the screenshot; US size (this file's default PLATE_W/PLATE_H, the real 12x6in standard) per the user's own identification of it as a US-style plate, the game being set in the US. plate_type is 'commercial' rather than 'passenger' since the vehicle is explicitly a company distribution van, unlike Dying Light's van above where no such distinction was evidenced.
